PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

2. C — Glucose and oxygen

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. C — Producers

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

9. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
